rows.upstream_expectation: Each skill package is anchored by a SKILL.md entrypoint.
rows.rationale: Gaia resolves only SKILL.md entrypoints from approved project/local roots and emits stable contract metadata.

rows.upstream_expectation: Skill frontmatter includes name/description and optional metadata fields.
rows.rationale: Gaia parses frontmatter, validates required fields, and preserves optional metadata without execution.

rows.upstream_expectation: Skill packages may include scripts/ and references/ directories alongside SKILL.md.
rows.rationale: Gaia static validation scans bounded file sets under the skill root, including scripts and references files.

rows.upstream_expectation: Unsafe instructions/scripts should be detected before skill execution.
rows.rationale: Gaia quality matrix enforces deterministic fail-on-malicious fixtures covering prompt injection, unsafe scripts, exfiltration, and reverse shell patterns.

rows.upstream_expectation: Skill execution should enforce runtime guardrails and approvals.
rows.rationale: Gaia sandbox profiles, escalation approvals, and per-skill policy decisions are validated as blocking guardrails in quality/UAT scenarios.

rows.upstream_expectation: Skill operations should be traceable for debugging and incident triage.
rows.rationale: Gaia emits correlated trace metadata across skills/policy/sandbox flows and exposes deterministic filters for forensic triage.

rows.upstream_expectation: Agent skills can be installed directly with npx tooling from upstream registries/repos.
rows.rationale: Gaia currently supports project/local skill roots and path validation, but does not yet provide a native remote install command equivalent to upstream npx installation flow.

evidence.value: Tracked as future enhancement after Phase 2 lane completion.
